title: Households in India, other Asia-Pacific regions highly vulnerable to El Nino-driven price shocks: S&P
desc: Asia-Pacific economies face rising prices and weather shocks from El Nino. Reduced rainfall and climate disruption will affect agricultural output and food inflation. Proactive policies will limit damage from the developing El Nino episode.
